messages:
Zoe Tran: Quick Q — took a late-night rideshare (app) back from client dinner. Driver asked for a cash tip (local currency). App only gave a generic trip receipt (no line for tip). Can I expense the tip? I paid cash 5,000 IDR. Receipt photo attached.

Marcus (People Ops): Short: yes, tips that are business-related (e.g., driver helped with luggage/equipment or late-night safety) can be expensed. For cash tips with no receipt, include a photo of the cash or envelope and a manager attestation. Prefer itemized receipts when possible.

Zoe Tran: I have the app trip receipt and a photo of the cash/receipt note. Manager approved in DM — is that sufficient?

Liam (Manager): Confirming I approve the 5,000 IDR tip for Zoe. Driver helped carry demo kit and it was late.

Elena (Accounting): Okay — upload the app trip receipt and the photo of the tip or a short note. Code the expense to "ground-transport" and set currency to IDR. We accept manager attestation for cash tips up to the equivalent of \u20ac25. Above that we need a third-party or supplier receipt.

Expense Bot: Reminder: if converting cash tips, we use the exchange rate on the expense date. VAT: tips are generally non-recoverable. If the app receipt shows zero tip, include a screenshot of the trip details.

Zoe Tran: Thanks all  submitting now with Liam's DM and attachments.
